verdict.rationale: First-party docs say search finds anything in the scrollback buffer, with forward (Ctrl Shift f / Cmd f) and backward (Ctrl Shift b / Cmd b) search. Vi mode adds `/` and `?` search, and `SearchStart`/`SearchEnd` actions jump to the start or end of a match. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of next/previous-match cycling keys and of search speed, plus any independent or hands-on corroboration of the search workflow.
